gloss: to think of, to hit upon

definitions.gloss: to think of, to come up with
definitions.explanation: To have an idea suddenly come to mind.

examples.japanese: いい{考|かんが}えを{思|おも}い{付|つ}いた。
examples.english: I thought of a good idea.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か{思|おも}い{付|つ}いたら{教|おし}えて。
examples.english: Let me know if you think of something.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に{思|おも}い{付|つ}いた。

notes:
{思|おも}い{付|つ}く is a godan verb meaning to think of or come up with an idea, often suddenly.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- The idea is the subject: いい{考|かんが}えが{思|おも}い{付|つ}いた
- Can also use を: いい{考|かんが}えを{思|おも}い{付|つ}いた

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いい{考|かんが}えを{思|おも}い{付|つ}く: to think of a good idea
- {急|きゅう}に{思|おも}い{付|つ}く: to suddenly occur to one
- {何|なに}か{思|おも}い{付|つ}いたら: if you think of something

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {思|おも}い{付|つ}き: a (sudden) idea, whim
- {思|おも}い{付|つ}きで: on a whim

SIMILAR VERBS:
- {思|おも}い{出|だ}す: to remember, recall
- {気|き}が{付|つ}く: to notice, realize
- {考|かんが}え{付|つ}く: to think up, devise
